episode_title: Go-to-Market and AI Success with Emin Can Turan from Pebbles Ai

real_qa.q: What does GTM (Go-to-Market) encompass in B2B business operations?
real_qa.r: GTM is the widest terminology that encapsulates marketing strategy, marketing execution, market intelligence, social media marketing, sales, and even product rollout. It describes the entire journey of a person from an unknown prospect all the way through becoming a customer and receiving ongoing support, functioning as a relay race where each team hands off the baton to the next.

real_qa.q: Why is energy management critical in an inefficient Go-to-Market approach?
real_qa.r: If you have a very inefficient GTM approach, you'll be taking calls and putting a lot of effort and time into the wrong channel with the wrong value propositions. Sales teams have a finite amount of dopamine per day—it's a muscle—and that dopamine and endorphins create enthusiasm, which is what you actually sell with, not just a generic pitch.

real_qa.q: How do persuasion science frameworks like ethos-pathos-logos apply to B2B sales funnels?
real_qa.r: The ethos-pathos-logos approach—credibility first, then pathos, then logos—is mapped across the B2B funnel. At the top, you push on credibility through five-star reviews and social proof; then you communicate why you're reaching out with a compelling story; finally, you present the logical terms and offer, such as a free trial with no credit card required upfront.
real_qa.requete: ethos pathos logos sales funnel B2B

real_qa.q: What role does Hofstede's Culture Matrix play in international Go-to-Market strategy?
real_qa.r: Hofstede's Culture Matrix maps clusters of values on individualism versus collectivism. The Dutch, Australians, New Zealand, UK, and America cluster together, making it easier to scale a successful marketing strategy from one country to another within that group. However, it's much harder to take a successful product from America to the Middle East or Far East without significant adaptation.
real_qa.requete: Hofstede culture matrix international marketing strategy

real_qa.q: What percentage of companies fail due to Go-to-Market related issues?
real_qa.r: Nine out of ten companies fail, but when you dig deep into the data, most of those failures can be attributed to go-to-market reasons—whether lacking a marketing strategy, having subpar market intelligence, pursuing a declining market, using wrong pricing strategies, or targeting the wrong ICPs with misaligned value propositions.

real_qa.q: What is Pebbles AI's pricing model for early adopters?
real_qa.r: The first 10,000 users will get the same pricing for an entire year, receive priority access to all features, and enjoy all the latest technology, while the pricing will eventually be tripled or quadrupled. Early adopters are essential for feedback loops and become the biggest evangelists if treated well.
